_comment: The seat roster, the alias map, and the retired seats with the reason each was retired.
CLAUDE.md's seat table GOVERNS. This file must agree with it, and tests/test_role_cards.py
fails if the two drift apart. roles/README.md holds a third copy and is not a source for
this file. The claim that its live table listed seven retired seats as live was retracted
in CLAUDE.md on 2026-09-10; that table named one retired seat, in a Replaces clause.
An unmapped label resolves to NOTHING. The hook never guesses.
_aliases_comment: Observed and near-miss spellings, collapsed onto the canonical seat. A canonical name is
never a key here: it resolves to itself. Numbered spellings exist because several sessions
hold the same seat at once and the number was appended to tell them apart, which turned one
seat into eight labels and made grouping by seat impossible.
_retired_comment: A retired label resolves to NO CARD, and the hook says it was retired rather than staying
silent. Silence would send the reader looking for a card that was deliberately removed.
Their playbooks stay in roles/retired/ as the record of what each seat did.
Nothing replaced the PM, the Cleaner, the Role manager or the Process improvement seat.
The console rows carry the two spellings that were aliased. A numbered spelling such as
console1 resolves to nothing, and the reply names the live seats.

retired.console: Retired 2026-09-10. The Manager replaces it. Broad oversight across every account did not work, so a Manager sits inside one account and runs its Builders as subagents or as separate sessions.
retired.consul: Retired 2026-09-10. A spelling of console, which the Manager replaces. See the console row.
retired.dispatcher: Retired 2026-09-01. The Console replaced it, and the Console itself retired 2026-09-10. The Manager now reads the record, picks the work and runs a Builder.
retired.liaison: Retired 2026-09-01. The Console replaced it, and the Console itself retired 2026-09-10. The Manager is the seat the Owner talks to.
retired.pm: Retired 2026-09-01 by Owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
retired.project-manager: Retired 2026-09-01 by Owner decision. Nothing replaced it. See roles/retired/PM.md.
retired.cleaner: Retired 2026-09-01 by Owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
retired.role-manager: Retired 2026-09-01 by Owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
retired.process-improvement: Retired 2026-09-01 by Owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
